contentSnippet: CNN political contributor Maggie Haberman explains the reasoning behind Donald Trump's attacks on the judge and his family during a speech at his Mar-a-Lago resort after he was arraigned on felony charges.

title: Video shows moment of deadly explosion at cafe in Russia

title: Not only is Lake Powell's water level plummeting because of drought, its total capacity is shrinking, too
